The structure of Lu6Al12C18 (reduced formula LuAl2C3) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 36 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral environments for all three elements: Al centers coordinate to six C neighbors, while C centers coordinate to three Al and three Lu neighbors, and Lu centers coordinate to six C neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Al octahedra and between C octahedra, and edge-sharing between Al and Lu octahedra.
